title: BIFC-14223: boosted implicit-fiber tree with linear quantum workspace

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and every secret s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the single BIFC-14223 algorithm completely specified in proof.md (finite exhaustive branch n<2^48; otherwise r=ceil(sqrt n), H=floor(2599r/2000), dl=ceil(1228r/10000), Qtarget=ceil(12994r/10000), A=H-dl, L4=ceil((Qtarget-A)/2), Mmax=A+L4, hmax=A+2L4, kappa=ceil(log2Mmax)+3, the capacity-minimal prefix of the prescribed binary/four-input tree with every four-input budget full, exact source-label extraction, bounded implicit pair-fiber listing and the full odd/two-adic decoder) recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8. On every execution branch total charged sequential work is T=O(2^((14223/10000)sqrt n)), with stronger main-branch bound O(n^6 2^(1.4222sqrt n)). All source, bit-operation, gate, address, initialization, precision, failed-attempt and reset costs are counted with absolute constants. The representative envelope has exact growth index1/2 and holds jointly with the other four claims.

For the same BIFC-14223 algorithm and configuration of proof.md, for every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n = ceil(log2 N), peak classical memory on every execution branch is S_C(N,s) = O(2^((13/10) sqrt n)) bits, with an absolute constant, including every retained capped merge table, implemented lookup scratch, parameter, source-extractor and decoder record. The stronger main-branch bound is S_C = O(n^(3/2) 2^(1.2995 sqrt n)). The envelope B_C(n) = 2^((13/10) sqrt n) has growth index exactly 1/2. This holds jointly with the stated work, quantum-memory and sample bounds and full-secret success probability at least 1 - 2^-8.

For the same BIFC-14223 algorithm and configuration in proof.md, every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), peak allocated accessible quantum workspace on every execution branch is S_Q=O(n), with an absolute constant. It includes up to four stacked tree index registers per level, the physical source/data and modular/LE scratch, implemented lookup ancillas, root qubits and all resets. There is no recycling pool, coherent source bank or QRAM. The representative envelope B_Q(n)=n has exact growth index0. The bound holds jointly with the stated time, classical-space and acquired-copy bounds and unconditional entire-secret success probability at least1-2^-8.

For the same BIFC-14223 algorithm and configuration of proof.md, for every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n = ceil(log2 N), the total number Q(N,s) of fresh DCP source copies acquired on every execution branch, including every discarded copy and every failed or aborted attempt, is O(2^((13/10) sqrt n)), with an absolute constant. The stronger main-branch bound is Q <= n Ccap + K = O(n^3 2^(1.2994 sqrt n)), with Ccap and K defined in proof.md. The uniform bit-length envelope B_samples(n) = 2^((13/10) sqrt n) has growth index exactly 1/2. This holds jointly with the stated work and memory bounds and unconditional full-secret success probability at least 1 - 2^-8.

For the same BIFC-14223 algorithm and configuration of proof.md, the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n) = 0: all Q source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N and s, full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1 - 2^-8 jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted; this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
